reviews.text:
I met Boncan after adopting Pochi when she was only 2 months old. She is a mix of mix, with a lot of Podenco, with all her craziness… and also with all her fears.

When the big day of the first walk arrived, we found ourselves in a situation that we would never have imagined: we didn't even get past the door of the apartment. 😅
And the days passed and we didn't make any progress. We didn't know what to do or how to solve it, and that's when we started our journey with Boncan.

From the first moment we found a great team: very understanding and respectful, both with the dog and the person. They don't make you feel judged and are always willing to help you, teach you new techniques and look for different possibilities, adapting them to each case.

With patience and work, now we can go out on the street! 🥰 And at home, Pochi is also starting to be calmer and no longer seems like a "kid" who doesn't stop for a second. 😂

It's not magic. It's a process. And with a fearful dog like Pochi, one day you take one step forward and the next day you take two steps back. But now we have tools to understand her better and, above all, to be able to help her.

We still have work to do, especially to finish working on socialization with other dogs. For this reason, we will take advantage of group outings to continue advancing in this part and continue learning together.

I recommend it 100%. Because, in our case, going from "not even reaching the landing" to being able to go out into the street, walk, pass by the terrace of a bar and, even, sit on a terrace with her... is quite an achievement. 😂

Thank you, Boncan, for accompanying us on this path, for being patient with us and helping us understand Pochi a little more every day. ❤️

Boncan has been a game-changer for us. We welcomed our little Leki at the beginning of the year and soon realized we needed help, not because the dog had any problems, but because we needed guidance to navigate this new chapter in our lives.

In our case, we grew up with dogs, but we hadn't been fully responsible for one. We found countless pieces of advice online, some contradicting others, creating a sense of frustration and mistrust that ultimately made us choose Boncan.
From our very first visit, they were friendly, clear, understanding, and patient. They explained the different courses they offered, and we opted for the longest one. At the time, we didn't realize how good that decision had been, but we soon would. If you're wondering which course to take, don't hesitate. It's better to pay a little more for the longer course and spend more time working with your dog, because now we're seeing the fruits of that labor. We know we'll have a well-balanced and well-behaved companion for another 10-15 years. It's an investment well worth it.
The sessions are incredible, not only for what they teach you but also for their willingness to answer absolutely all your questions, adapting to what works best for each family. They truly made us feel like part of their family, and we formed wonderful bonds with the entire Boncan team, as well as with other trainers and their dogs.
I hope this message helps anyone who's unsure which trainers to choose. If we had to choose again, we'd go back a thousand times over without hesitation.
Thank you so much, Boncan team, you're the best!

Very good experience, 100% recommendable. They helped us both when choosing the dog, and during the first months to learn how to educate it and, above all, understand it.

Thanks to the whole team and especially to Diego, who accompanied us throughout the process, always willing and with a smile. Flick already misses him :)

We can only be grateful to you! We decided to contact Boncan because our little dog was very reactive and had many fears, walking her was very complicated because she reacted to everything that moved. Thanks to them we learned to understand her, to know what was happening to her but above all to communicate with her. The relationship changed and improved a lot and both she and we enjoy the walks and excursions. After three years, we can still go on excursions and outings with Boncan and they listen to the doubts and queries we have. We are sure that we would repeat it a thousand times! Thank you for everything :)
Highly recommended! Professional and friendly, a 10 out of 10 for both us and our dog Nana!

Today we had a session/interview with Gemma from Boncan. My daughter chose the Border Collie breed as her school research topic, and that's why we arranged the interview. Gemma's level of information, clarity, knowledge, passion, and commitment to her work and her furry friends was impressive. Amazing! She gave us a masterclass on this breed and on dogs in general. We came away with a wealth of relevant information to improve our dog's quality of life and have even more fun with her!

Thank you so much, Gemma! We will definitely be back if we have any questions or need to address any issues.

If you have a dog and have any questions, behavioral problems, or simply want to improve your pet's situation, don't hesitate to contact us.

Amazing professionals!! In my case, I was lucky enough to have Gemma as my trainer (and coach).

She helped us tremendously. We did the short program, and she gave us the keys to understanding our puppy (Weasley, a 5-month-old dachshund) and how to train him so we wouldn't have any behavioral or housebreaking problems.

They are incredibly attentive and loving with the dogs; you can tell they love what they do and are passionate about it. Without a doubt, I would use their services again and again!

Dolça is 5 years old but spent 4 years in a shelter. She's only been with us for 5 months, and despite being a very affectionate and docile dog with people, she's very reactive with most other dogs. We don't know what negative experiences she might have had. When she'd been with us for about a month, we decided to ask for help because walks were a source of stress for both her and us. We contacted David and began this adventure to learn and acquire all the necessary tools to help Dolça reduce this reactivity. Although we still have a long way to go, walks with Dolça have improved considerably, and we know things can only get better. Thank you, David, Gemma, Diego, and Carlota, for the patience and love you show at all times and for your excellent work.

They are all incredible. We were with David and Gemma the most and we only have good words for them and the rest of the team. Our dog Nacho had a certain reactivity that was born of fear since a dog attacked him a couple of times, and things that seem normal in a dog, were difficult for him... The most important thing for us is not everything that he has improved, but how they have taught us to understand him and give him the tools to be able to solve situations with a different energy, and this, being able to understand him, is what marked a 360 change for us as a family. Boncan are passionate, respectful and you can see that they accompany us from absolute love towards the furry ones. In addition, they helped us adapt to the arrival of our first child in a generous and altruistic way, and we can say that Nacho is the best brother in the world. Thank you endlessly team!
